The Trade Coalition is the name of the goblins' merchant empire. The Venture Company is part of the coalition, as are presumably all goblin organizations and cartels, including the Trade Fleets.

Tradesman Portanuus is a draenei quest giver and vendor located in the Sun's Reach Sanctum of the Isle of Quel'Danas once players have retaken the sanctum in the second phase. He later traveled to and is seen in Yrel's Watch as an Alliance vendor. He also visits Lunarfall provided the Trading Post is built.

Trade Prince Steamwheedle is or was the trade prince of the Steamwheedle Cartel. During the Second War, he allied his cartel with the Horde, the only trade prince to do so. Rumors on Kezan suggested that he was making a significant profit from his alleged exclusivity contract with the faction. After the war ended with the Horde's defeat, he returned the cartel to their usual neutrality. It's not known if he still leads the cartel, since hasn't been mentioned since the immediate aftermath of the Second War.
Tracker Gekgek is a wolvar quest giver found at Skyreach Pillar in Sholazar Basin. He, along with two other wolvar, can be found cornering Pitch.

Trade chat, also known as the trade channel, is a common chat channel that only works in capital cities. It is linked across all such cities on a single realm (with connected realms sharing a trade chat). This channel is intended for buying, selling, and trading of items and services, but it is often used for general chit-chat, gold spamming and guild recruitment as well. The channel is also heavily used instead of the LookingForGroup channel to recruit players for group activities, particularly instance types without an automated group finder. Players are flagged to access the Tournament Realm via the Proving Grounds, the starting stage of the MDI.

Tower Knowledge is the currency used for The Box of Many Things in Torghast, Tower of the Damned, to advance meta-progression in the tower. To unlock Tower Knowledge, players must find the broker Ve'nish somewhere in the tower. He starts The Box of Many Things (quest). Turn in to the Runecarver, then pick up and complete Tower Knowledge (quest). Like Conquest and Valor, Tower Knowledge has a rolling seasonal cap that increases from week to week to keep players from grinding out the entire tree in one week. Week 11 is the final maximum amount needed to unlock all ranks of the Box of Many Things, making Many, Many Things possible.

It may also drop some Korthian Armaments, some cosmetic items including: Cold Burden of the Damned, Exterminator's Crest of the Damned, and Watchful Eye of the Damned. Additionally, the Soul-Enveloping Leggings, Mawsworn Lieutenant's Treads, Sabatons of the Towering Construct, and Mawsworn Exterminator's Hauberk are on the loot table.

Transborea is a subzone in the Borean Tundra. The term is used to describe the snowy, largely Scourge-controlled region in the far eastern area of this zone. As "trans" means "across" or "beyond" and "borea" may be a shortening of Borean Tundra, the name may refer to that it is a field that is beyond the tundra (being on the other side).

Trainee is a new moniker for Blizzard employees in training on the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. The Trainee account is currently not in use.

Tranquil Wash is a medium-sized cave found directly southwest of Nespirah in Shimmering Expanse. Claimed by the Alliance this cavern is where many of the survivors from Nespirah are taken, along with the adventurer while escaping before Nespirah's bio-defenses kill everything inside her.
Trapspring Leggings is a quest reward from The Grand Tablet.

The Tranquil Coast is the western shoreline of the larger Lost Isles. It's here the Alliance paratroopers are landing for a final assault on the Warchief Thrall. The Alliance soldiers placed several gnomish land mines on the beach to protect the three SI:7 leaders, that lead the attack.

Transients are homeless citizens of Westfall who can be found throughout the zone and appear to carry their belongings in bags on sticks, stereotypical of a hobo in American culture. They have a buff called "Hobo Stick" that has no effect but says "What's in the bag?" Along with the other NPCs at the Jansen Stead, the Transients there will say things like "I miss being robbed by the Defias. At least they'd leave you a little something to eat from time to time." (A reference to taxation to pay for the war in Northrend.) They are among the NPCs there who must be interrogated there for Murder Was The Case That They Gave Me. Like other characters in Westfall, they are neutral rather than friendl

Trained Fire Hawks are Fire hawks that have been trained by Morthis Whisperwing and the Guardians of Hyjal. Their life cycle is very rapid; the one you are given to ride is only two days old yet is full grown.
Tranquil Mind Totem was a talent planned to be introduced with Mists of Pandaria.
The Tranquil Grotto is a small area across the bridge from the Dawning Valley on the Wandering Isle. It's here one of the eldest students of Master Shang Xi, Jaomin Ro, can be found.
Trainee Guang is a pandaren found in the Dawning Valley on the Wandering Isle.
Trainee Nim is a pandaren found in the Dawning Valley on the Wandering Isle.
Trainee's Handwrap is found by interacting with a weapon rack in front of Master Shang Xi at the Shang Xi Training Grounds on the Wandering Isle.
Training Bags are level 85 training dummies found at the Ring of Balance of the Jade Forest.
Trained Brineshell Snappers are the turtle pets of Muckscale Flesh-Hunters, found in the Briny Muck of Dread Wastes.
Transmute: Living Steel is an alchemy transmute. The transmute shares a cooldown with the other daily-cooldown alchemy transmutes.

__NOTOC__ Traitor Gluk is a master Pet Tamer located in front of Dire Maul in Feralas. He is in a small camp with his level 13 battle pets: Rasp (Beast), Prancer (Critter), and Glimmer (Dragonkin). He sometimes kicks Rasp while trying to train the snake. Prancer is kept in a cage behind him. Glimmer is behind the tree at the back of the camp. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Kalimdor and Taming Azeroth achievements.
Training Hawks are a level 90 hawks that can be found at the Secret Aerie on the Veiled Stair. The hawks are being trained by Hawkmaster Liu.

Training Quarters is a chamber in the Heart of Fear used in training young mantid in the ways of battle techniques. Instructors Kil'thak, Maltik, Tak'thok, and Zarik see to training the swarm while Blade Lord Ta'yak watches over them.
__NOTOC__ Trained Saurid are saurid found at the Beast Pens on Isle of Thunder. They spawn in groups of three-four.
Trank is a goblin engineering vendor located at Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Tranquil Master is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for killing the Sha's corruption by defeating each known manifestation of negative emotion.
